capabilities: Run snippets from the command palette
Reload all snippet commands after snippets change
disambiguation: It does not create or edit snippets themselves; it only exposes existing CSS snippets as commands.
extras: The README marks the plugin as experimental and includes standard security and installation notes; it is free and open source.
problem: CSS snippets can only be toggled through settings, with no way to trigger them quickly via the command palette or a hotkey.
summary: Command registration plugin that turns each CSS snippet into a command, so snippets can be run from the command palette or bound to hotkeys.
